Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Hi all m8s, as u can read my question is very simple, what happen if a
>vampire play a Drawing & another Vamp play in the same combat Terror
>Frenzy?

I assume you mean inferior Terror Frenzy.

>What effect card will prevaliced & why?

Both are in effect.

>Are both cards canceled??

No.

So Vampire A plays Drawing Out the Beast and Vampire B plays Terror Frenzy
(inf).

Range starts out at close. Vampire A (under TF effect) can manuever to long if
he wants but Vampire B (under DotB effect) cannot. If Vampire A manuevers to
long, Vampire B can manuever to close. Etc, etc. Only Vamp A can manuever to
long and only Vamp B can manuever to close. Either can still use effects to set
range (if they don't involve manuevers).

Neither vampire can use equipiment. Vampire B gains the +1 strength but takes a
damage during press stage. And only Vampire B can try to press to continue, and
only Vampire A can try to press to end.

Questions?

Halcyan 2
